entries.prompt: 微距特写，一个生物体独自占据画面：它立在冻原的石面上、整体朝向镜头：a dense mat of pale fungal mycelium with branching fruticose lichen tufts standing up like tiny shrubs, fine branching threads and a soft dusty surface. on a frost-covered stone in open tundra. low backlight through ice fog, rimming every tip. a low three-quarter macro view, 90mm macro lens at f/8, macro photograph, focus-stacked, fine surface detail, natural colour, no digital sharpening, no text, no watermark.
